class_id: an extractor that returns an empty array (no promoters, no peers, no rows) for a real document writes nothing to explain the absence — the row is indistinguishable from 'never extracted'
feature: any document extractor field whose success value is a list (promoters, peer companies, risk factors, anchor investors) rather than a scalar; filing-persister.ts writing the field_sources / field_extraction_failures tables for those fields
symptom: when the extractor genuinely finds nothing on the page (a bad parse, a layout variant it does not handle, or a document that really has no peers), the persister wrote neither a field_sources row (no value) nor a field_extraction_failures row (no reason) for an empty-array result. Downstream, a reader cannot tell 'this document was read and had no peers' from 'this document's peer extraction has never run' or 'the parser silently failed'. Measured 2026-09-27 on staging (#545): after the promoters/peers writer was rebuilt, 5 of 7 re-extracted IPOs still returned 0 rows post-fix with zero stored explanation (papadmalji, peshwa-wheat, roopa-screen SME covers barely parsed; moneyview and acevector's cover wording was missed by read_cover_promoters). The wider shape: any list-valued extractor field is exempt from the ordinary field_sources/field_extraction_failures contract that scalar fields get, because 'wrote an empty list' looks like 'wrote nothing' at the code level.
first_seen: 2026-09-27 20:06 IST, IPODhan, issue #545 (contract 1 investigation): filing-persister.ts:2384-2419 — an empty promoters/peers result from extract_filing.py took no field_sources or field_extraction_failures branch; confirmed on 5 of 7 real staging RHP/DRHP documents (orient-cables, green-asia partially recovered by PR #1161; papadmalji, peshwa-wheat, roopa-screen, moneyview, acevector still silent at the time of measurement).
fix_prs: #1244 (2026-09-27): a genuinely empty promoters/peers result now writes a field_extraction_failures row with rule_id NOT_PRINTED (moved off field_sources/EXTRACTION_FAILED after Tier A review found the first placement was unread by the floor); no reason is written when rows already exist (srit-india-ltd case); the reason is resolved (cleared) when a later read writes real names. #1246 (deferred, filed 2026-09-27) tracks the remaining SME-cover parse gap and NOT_PRINTED-vs-reader-miss ambiguity as follow-up, not yet fixed.
detection_check: none dedicated. `prospectus_promoters_peers_yield` (added alongside PR #1161) reports the staging-wide zero-promoter/zero-peer counts but does not assert a reason row exists for every empty result — a document could still have neither a value nor a stored reason and this check would only show it as a low-yield count, not name the specific row. No CI test asserts 'every list-valued extraction has either a field_sources row or a field_extraction_failures row, never neither'.
